name: CLIENT_ID
label: OAuth client ID
setupSteps: Create a Slack app (from scratch) in the workspace you want gadgets to use.
Under OAuth & Permissions, add the redirect URL below.
Do NOT enable token rotation (OAuth & Permissions > Token Rotation). It cannot be turned off once enabled and breaks two-way messaging (bot tokens are not refreshed).

For two-way events and replies, add the bot scopes chat:write, app_mentions:read, channels:history, commands, files:read, im:history, im:read. Enable Event Subscriptions with Request URL {PUBLIC_BASE_URL}/gatekeeper/slack/events and subscribe to app_mention, message.im, message.channels, and file_shared; then install the app so a bot token is issued.
Copy the app's Client ID and Client Secret (Basic Information > App Credentials) here.

name: SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET
label: Signing secret (required for two-way / inbound events)
setupSteps: Copy the app's Signing Secret (Basic Information > App Credentials) here.

Required for inbound events and slash commands: /events and /commands verify Slack's request signature and fail closed (401) until this is set, so Slack cannot even verify the Event Subscriptions Request URL without it.
Read-only (user-token) installs that never receive events can leave this unset.
